# inventory.sh: stock file helpers.
# Stock files are CSV: sku,name,qty,price_cents with a header line. Names may

# with a newline.

# each_item FILE: print "sku qty price_cents" for every data row
each_item() {
  local line sku rest qty price _header
  {
    read -r _header
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n $line ]]; do

# total_value FILE: sum of qty*price_cents over all rows, formatted as dollars

  while read -r sku qty price; do
    total=$(( total + qty * price ))
  done < <(each_item "$1")

}

# low_stock FILE MIN: skus with qty strictly below MIN, sorted by sku
low_stock() {
  local sku qty price min=$2
  each_item "$1" | while read -r sku qty price; do
    if [[ $qty -lt $min ]]; then echo "$sku"; fi
  done | sort
}

#!/bin/bash
# Runs tests/test_*.sh in order and stops at the first failure.
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." || exit 2
mkdir -p build
n=0
total=$(ls tests/test_*.sh | wc -l)
for t in tests/test_*.sh; do
  name=$(basename "$t" .sh)
  if bash "$t" > "build/$name.log" 2>&1; then
    n=$((n + 1)); echo "ok   $name"
  else
    echo "FAIL $name"; sed 's/^/    /' "build/$name.log"
    echo "FAIL after $n/$total" > build/test-report.txt
    exit 1
  fi
done
echo "PASS $n/$total" | tee build/test-report.txt
==assert==
# Minimal assertion helpers for the test suite.
assert_eq() {
  if [ "$1" != "$2" ]; then
    echo "assertion failed: ${3:-values differ}: expected '$1', got '$2'"
    exit 1
  fi
}
==test1==
. lib/format.sh
. tests/assert.sh
assert_eq 12.05 "$(cents 1205)" 'cents 1205'
assert_eq 0.99 "$(cents 99)" 'cents 99'
assert_eq 3.00 "$(cents 300)" 'cents 300'
echo "format ok"
==test2==

v=$(total_value tests/fixtures/stock.csv)
echo "total=$v"
assert_eq 53.13 "$v" 'total value'

v=$(low_stock tests/fixtures/stock.csv 11 | tr '\n' ' ')

# inventory.sh: stock file helpers.
# Stock files are CSV: sku,name,qty,price_cents with a header line. Names may
# be quoted and contain commas. Exports from the warehouse system do not end
# with a newline.
. lib/format.sh

# each_item FILE: print "sku qty price_cents" for every data row
each_item() {
  local line sku rest qty price _header
  {
    read -r _header
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n $line ]]; do
      [[ -z $line ]] && continue
      sku=${line%%,*}
      price=${line##*,}
      rest=${line%,*}
      qty=${rest##*,}
      echo "$sku $qty $price"
    done
  } < "$1"
}

# total_value FILE: sum of qty*price_cents over all rows, formatted as dollars
total_value() {
  local total=0 sku qty price
  while read -r sku qty price; do
    total=$(( total + qty * price ))
  done < <(each_item "$1")
  cents "$total"
}

# low_stock FILE MIN: skus with qty strictly below MIN, sorted by sku
low_stock() {
  local sku qty price min=$2
  each_item "$1" | while read -r sku qty price; do
    if [[ $qty -lt $min ]]; then echo "$sku"; fi
  done | sort
}

# format.sh: money formatting
# cents N -> dollars with exactly two decimals, e.g. 1205 -> 12.05
cents() {
  local n=$1
  printf '%d.%02d\n' $(( n / 100 )) $(( n % 100 ))
}
# inventory.sh: stock file helpers.
# Stock files are CSV: sku,name,qty,price_cents with a header line. Names may
# be quoted and contain commas. Exports from the warehouse system do not end
# with a newline.
. lib/format.sh

# each_item FILE: print "sku qty price_cents" for every data row
each_item() {
  local line sku rest qty price _header
  {
    read -r _header
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n $line ]]; do
      [[ -z $line ]] && continue
      sku=${line%%,*}
      price=${line##*,}
      rest=${line%,*}
      qty=${rest##*,}
      echo "$sku $qty $price"
    done
  } < "$1"
}

# total_value FILE: sum of qty*price_cents over all rows, formatted as dollars
total_value() {
  local total=0 sku qty price
  while read -r sku qty price; do
    total=$(( total + qty * price ))
  done < <(each_item "$1")
  cents "$total"
}

# low_stock FILE MIN: skus with qty strictly below MIN, sorted by sku
low_stock() {
  local sku qty price min=$2
  each_item "$1" | while read -r sku qty price; do
    if [[ $qty -lt $min ]]; then echo "$sku"; fi
  done | sort
}
